answer_1.quote: We implement the Actor module using an LLM and adapt its generated recommendations to the dataset using an item grounding process.
answer_1.outputs: Sequences of recommended items (textual item names) generated by the LLM-based Actor

answer_2.quote: We employ both LLM-based and traditional metrics. LLM-based metrics leverage autonomous LLMs to simulate users to assess the effectiveness of the recommendations. Traditional metrics are based on a simulator that utilizes the Transformer model to evaluate the performance. We employ Increment of Interest (IoI) and Increment of Rank (IoR) as experimental metrics...
